name: Kindred
source:
When tragedy brings your sisters together, your coven's magic powers awaken... along with an onslaught of dark forces.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Kindred]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
当悲剧让你的姐妹们走到一起时，你的女巫会的魔法力量就会苏醒……伴随着黑暗力量的猛攻。

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Kindred]Choices Wikia[/url]]
